'''FC Spaeri''' ([[Georgian language|Georgian]]: საფეხბურთო კლუბი სპაერი) is a Georgian professional [[association football]] club based in [[Tbilisi]]. Following the [[2025 Erovnuli Liga 2|2025 season]], the club gained promotion to [[Erovnuli Liga]], the top tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]].

Along with [[FC Gagra|Gagra]], they are the only 2nd division club to have won the [[Georgian Cup]].<ref>{{cite news |title=სპაერმა საქართველოს თასი "დინამოს" არ დაანება |url=https://atiani.ge/2024/12/05/spaerma-saqarthvelos-thasi-dinamos-ar-daaneba/ |access-date=8 March 2025 |website=atiani.ge |date=5 December 2024 |language=KA}}</ref>"}}
